name: natlang-triage-example
description: Triage a JSON list of support tickets into a report.

triage.description: Triage the bundled tickets, or supply your own JSON file and rubric.

arguments.name: tickets
arguments.description: Optional JSON file of tickets, relative to the dashboard root or command working directory. Leave blank for the bundled tickets.

arguments.name: rubric
arguments.description: Optional category definitions. Leave blank for billing, technical and spam.

inputs.ticket: Checkout fails with a 500 error for every customer.
inputs.rubric: billing: charges, invoices and payments; technical: outages, errors and bugs; spam: advertising

inputs.ticket: Checkout fails with a 500 error for every customer.
